meta.note: Descriptors are real dscribe outputs for the center atom (index 0). The 3D Gaussian cloud in the page is a separate visualization, not the descriptor computation. mu1nu1 is the mu=1, nu=1 compression from Darby et al.

dimer.label: Dimer
dimer.description: One carbon, one oxygen. The simplest environment.

tetra.label: Tetrahedral
tetra.description: Four hydrogens around a central carbon.

octa.label: Octahedral
octa.description: Six oxygens on the axes around a central carbon.

distorted.label: Distorted mixed
distorted.description: Five neighbors, mixed species and uneven distances.

compression.method: PCA (2 components), fit on 80 random clusters at r_cut=4.0
